title: ICBM Development, Operations, and Sustainment (IDOS) Update
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE NUCLEAR WEAPON CENTER.INTERCONTINENTAL BALLISTIC MISSILE.FA8207  AFNWC PZBC
detail_text: The Government extends its appreciation to our industry partners for their continued patience as the IDOS acquisition strategy matures. The purpose of this notice is to provide a brief update on the progression of the IDOS Program. The program team is awaiting authorization on several key details of its strategy and will release additional information in the coming weeks, upon receipt of all necessary approvals.
